test_str_count: test the pandas StringMethods count method to count regex pattern matches in a Series
test_str_normalize: test the pandas StringMethods normalize method to apply Unicode normalization forms like NFC and NFKC
test_str_ismethods: test the pandas StringMethods isalpha isdigit isnumeric and other is* methods on string Series
test_str_slice: test the pandas StringMethods slice method with start stop and step parameters for string extraction
test_str_index: test the pandas StringMethods index and rindex methods to find substring positions in a Series
